get.description: Get Tax Project Codes for a given project

parameters.name: company_id
parameters.description: Unique identifier for the company.

parameters.name: project_id
parameters.description: Unique identifier for the project.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page

parameters.name: per_page
parameters.description: Elements per page

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Direction (asc/desc) can be controlled by the presence or absence of '-' before the sort parameter

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: List of tax code ids

parameters.name: code
parameters.description: List of tax codes

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: include archived or active tax codes

parameters.name: include_rate
parameters.description: Whether to include rate data

parameters.name: erp_synced
parameters.description:
Whether to filter results to only ERP-synced codes.
- `true`: Return **only ERP-synced** codes.
- `false`: Return **all** project codes.

parameters.name: effective_as_of
parameters.description: ISO 8601 date string to filter tax codes effective on or after this date. For example, '2024-01-01' returns codes whose rate is valid from January 1, 2024 onward.

parameters.name: query
parameters.description: Partial Search tax codes by code or description

parameters.name: type
parameters.description:
Filter by tax code type. Omit to return both.
- `code` — Return only tax codes (non-groups).
- `group` — Return only tax groups.

parameters.name: exclude_untaxed
parameters.description: When true, exclude tax-exempt codes (where untaxed = true).

parameters.name: include_components
parameters.description: When true, include component tax codes and their rates for group tax codes (components array in each group).

parameters.name: include_group_membership
parameters.description: When true, include member_of_groups (groups this tax code is a component of) for each tax code.

Per-Page.description: Number of items retrieved per page

Total.description: Total number of items to be retrieved

Link.description: Link headers for the first, prev, next, and last link

id.description: Unique string identifier for this tax code. Use as the {id} path parameter in PATCH /rest/v2.0/companies/{company_id}/tax/codes/{id} to update this code.

code.description: Short identifier string for the tax code (e.g., 'GST-10'). Must be unique within the company. Required on create.

description.description: Human-readable description of the tax code's purpose (e.g., 'Goods and Services Tax'). Nullable.

archived.description: Whether this tax code has been archived. Archived codes are excluded from active selection unless status=ARCHIVED is passed. true = archived, false = active.

display_in_budget.description: Whether the tax code should be displayed in budget views

is_group.description: Whether this tax code is a group that aggregates multiple component tax codes

effective_start_date.description: ISO 8601 date string for when this tax rate becomes effective (e.g., '2024-01-01'). The rate applies to transactions on or after this date.

effective_end_date.description: ISO 8601 date string for when this tax rate expires. Null if this is the current active rate with no scheduled successor.

created_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when this rate record was created.

invoice_tax_application.description: Specifies how tax is applied on invoices. One of: 'NET' (tax calculated on the net/pre-tax amount), 'GROSS' (tax calculated on the gross/total amount), 'NONE' (used for group tax codes — the effective rate is the aggregate of its component codes' rates).

id.description: String ID of the user who created this tax rate. Use with the Users API to retrieve user details.

name.description: Display name of the user who created this tax rate.

components.description: Present when include_components=true; component tax codes and rates for group tax codes.

code.description: Short identifier string of this component tax code.

rate.description: Numeric tax rate percentage for this component (e.g., 10.0 = 10%).

invoice_tax_application.description: How tax is applied for this component on invoices. One of: 'NET' (applied to the net amount), 'GROSS' (applied to the gross amount), 'NONE' (used for group tax codes where the effective rate is the aggregate of components).

member_of_groups.description: Present when include_group_membership=true; groups this tax code is a component of (same shape as components).

code.description: Short identifier string of this group tax code.

rate.description: Numeric effective rate for this group, which is the sum of its component rates.

invoice_tax_application.description: How tax is applied for this group on invoices. One of: 'NET' (applied to the net amount), 'GROSS' (applied to the gross amount), 'NONE' (used for group tax codes where the effective rate is the aggregate of components).

import http.client

conn = http.client.HTTPSConnection("api.procore.com")

conn.request("GET", "/rest/v2.0/companies/%7Bcompany_id%7D/projects/%7Bproject_id%7D/tax/codes?page=SOME_INTEGER_VALUE&per_page=SOME_INTEGER_VALUE&sort=SOME_STRING_VALUE&id=SOME_ARRAY_VALUE&code=SOME_ARRAY_VALUE&status=SOME_ARRAY_VALUE&include_rate=SOME_BOOLEAN_VALUE&erp_synced=SOME_BOOLEAN_VALUE&effective_as_of=SOME_STRING_VALUE&query=SOME_STRING_VALUE&type=SOME_STRING_VALUE&exclude_untaxed=SOME_BOOLEAN_VALUE&include_components=SOME_BOOLEAN_VALUE&include_group_membership=SOME_BOOLEAN_VALUE")

res = conn.getresponse()
data = res.read()

print(data.decode("utf-8"))

x-changelog.summary: Add `type`, `exclude_untaxed`, `include_components`, and `include_group_membership` parameters to Project List Tax Codes
x-changelog.description:
Add optional filters and options to the Project List Tax Codes endpoint:
- `type` — Filter by kind: "code" (non-groups) or "group".
- `exclude_untaxed` — When true, exclude untaxed (zero-rate) codes.
- `include_components` — When true, include component tax codes and their rates for group codes.
- `include_group_membership` — When true, include parent groups for each component code.

This endpoint was previously private and in pilot, and is now publicly
documented in open beta. No changes were made to the API contract, only
visibility and stage updates.
